parsed_json.up: Select molecule ChEMBL identifier as compound_chembl_id and canonical SMILES. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, then to assays on assay_id, then to target_dictionary on tid. Filter for target pref_name 'Adenosine A2a receptor' and organism 'Homo sapiens'. Require structures by inner joining compound_structures on molregno. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
